findings.F1: The giveback does not appear on the folds shown. On the plan's grid, the 223 signal cases (forecast below 0) were followed by a further rise over the next 5 days: +1.56 % above the coin's normal drift (t 1.49), a strength of +0.136 in the long direction. This matches step 5's strength of -0.102 in the short direction and its slope t of -0.79, so the result points against the idea rather than for it.
findings.F2: No horizon shows a fall after the signal. The drift-removed move is positive at 1, 3, 5 and 10 days: +0.20 % (t 1.03, 1,133 cases), +0.50 % (t 0.87, 379), +1.56 % (t 1.49, 223) and +0.88 % (t 0.38, 108).
findings.F3: The giveback is absent in every coin and in every year with more than 12 cases. All six coins rose after the signal, with strengths from +0.029 (ZEC) to +0.247 (LTC). By year, 2019 was +0.95 %, 2020 was -0.14 % and 2021 was +3.39 % (t 1.70). The only negative year, 2018, had 12 cases (-1.06 %, t -0.20).
findings.F4: In rising agitated markets, a larger distance above the 20-day average carries no gradient. The day-clustered slope of the 5-day excess return on the distance is -0.0054 (t -0.54, 171 cases, 81 days). By distance quartile, the excess returns are +3.6 %, +2.8 %, -0.1 % and +3.1 %, so there is no graded fall. The strongest forecasts (most negative quartile, +1.06 %) are no different from the weakest (+0.48 %).
findings.F5: Where any gradient shows, it is continuation, not giveback, and it is not clear. In rising non-agitated (calm) markets the slope is +0.0154 (t 1.78, 142 cases, 51 days), and the top distance quartile gained +6.6 % (strength +0.53). In choppy markets the slope is +0.0199 (t 1.75, 65 cases). Both are short of t 2 and split by coin (ETH t 2.56 and XMR t 2.27, against LTC t -1.63 and ZEC t -0.71).
findings.F6: Being above the average was followed by a rise in every regime. The 5-day excess return was +2.37 % in rising agitated markets (t 1.52 day-clustered, 171 cases) and +2.94 % in rising calm ones (t 2.06, 142). No subset holds the fall the brief claims, so the result has no part where the idea shows and to which it could be narrowed.

no_ideas: The theme's effect is not in the data: a coin far above its 20-day average in a rising agitated market kept rising over the next 1 to 10 days, in every coin and every year with enough cases, with no graded giveback (F1–F4). The only gradient, continuation in calm and choppy markets, is too weak and too mixed across coins to make a clear idea (F5, F6).
